schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The Form, embodied — the base-most layer of the whole spine, composing no one and composed by everyone. Seven files under one charter: (1) core_values.py — the frozen CP1-CP6 contract (`CoreValue`, `CORE_VALUES`, `CoreValuesMixin`); (2) device.py — `BaseDevice`, which composes the mixin and declares the Form v0 #2 introspection surface (intention -> state -> settings -> other, assembled in order by concrete `introspect()`); (3) shim.py — `BaseShim`, which composes the mixin, pins `device_id`, and carries the per-pulse PROBE-FIRING: on each ground_loop heartbeat pulse, a device's shim evaluates its device's probes (each trigger where its data is owned, Law 6) and POKES the target of every one that fires, onto the bus — it also receives the device's mail and STARTS the device (its own process) on demand; (4) probe.py — the `Probe` primitive: an immutable 'poke X when this trigger is true', where a trigger is ANY predicate (not a named kind), the anti-reification made structural. Because both bases mix in `CoreValuesMixin`, every device and every shim carries the six structurally — you cannot be a device or a shim without them; and because probe-firing lives in the shim base, 'hang your probes on the heartbeat' is built into every device by inheritance, not re-implemented per device. The Form v0 #2 surface now has its first RENDER-side consumer built into the base pair (web-server ticket, child a): `BaseDevice.declared_panes()` lets a device OFFER extra panes beyond the STATUS+SETTINGS floor (each a handler returning DATA), and `BaseShim.active_page()` is the standard assembly — it projects the floor from `introspect()`, appends the declared panes in order (multiples of a kind allowed), renders an unwired or raising handler ABSENT-with-reason (CP2/Law 7), and returns pure DATA the web server renders. The machinery lives once in the base (Law 6), not per device. (5) diagnostic.py — `DiagnosticBase`, composed by `BaseDevice` so every device inherits `emit()` the way it inherits CP1-CP6: the transition-grade diagnostic surface Cairn lacked (outcome-grade VALIDATIONs/journeys said what PASSED; nothing spoke when system_rackmount went red SILENTLY). At a gate contact a device sends a THIN breadcrumb home to CC's shim (the diagnostic mailbox, for now — `BaseShim.receive_diagnostic`/`diagnostics()`), pointing to the ticket (`pointer`, the tie) and stamped to the microsecond (which indexes the fuller 30-day cache-class logs). The gate issues it — not the ticket; the emission stays dumb so the interpreter that crawls it can be smart (Law 1). Only the µs-stamp idea is carried from UU's `DiagnosticBase`; the loguru/JSON-sink backend is not. (6) transitions.py — the EMIT-CHOKEPOINT, the RULES rung of the state-transition trichotomy (state-machine-physics.json / harbor-master.json): the one door a workflow's cursor moves through. It parses the versioned workflow string (`code-seam@v1: THINKME -> ... -> [CURSOR] -> ... -> PROVED`), validates a requested transition against the class DEFINITION's machine-readable `workflow_versions` table (node_classes/<class>.json) + the -ME grammar (a summons ends -ME; forward advances or skips only declared-skippable summonses like TICKETME; a back-edge re-enters any earlier summons, carrying severity), REFUSES the illegal (a skip past a gate, an off-vocabulary target, an unknown class/version, a no-op, a path that does not conform to the version it claims), and journals the legal crossing append-only through the projector door (the charter-split's write-door — the TRUTH rung mechanism). It turns /sorted's prose 'refuses illegal transitions' into physics (Law 4). AUTHORITY (who may) is NOT here and never will be — that is the harbor_master's clearance gate (harbor-master child b); base owns the rules + the recording mechanism. CORRECTED 2026-08-10 (ticket emit-refuses-an-uncleared-crossing), and the superseded words are kept because they were the load-bearing falsehood: this read 'which WRAPS THIS CALL', which invited the reading that every emit caller necessarily passed through clearance. It never did — measured, 0 of 186 emit-shaped records on disk had ever carried cleared_by. What is true since 2026-08-10 is narrower and is physics: clearance is a SIXTH SEAT AT THIS SAME DOOR, a sibling of the five gates already inside emit, and it fires on a FORWARD JOURNALED CROSSING INTO A REST — the move that enters proven-space. Such a crossing carries the harbor's witness (cleared_by + the proof and seal it leaned on) or is refused before anything is written (ClearanceRequiredRed), and base RE-READS the Law 8 half of that witness against the world rather than trusting it. Base still asks WHO MAY nothing: it verifies only that the authority rung RAN, which is a Law 7 record-completeness question, and it imports nothing from harbor_master — not even an exception type. (7) nest.py — the block-general BAND VOCABULARY, ASSEMBLY and SHAKE (ruling 2026-08-07-the-nest-is-block-general, ticket banding-berths-at-the-general-level): `BAND_NAMES` (data — a tenant may extend it), `nest(reaches)` — bands assembled coarsest-first, empty bands omitted — and `shake(assembled, subjects, fire)` — the tenant brings the firing closure; the general side owns the coarse-first ordering, the binary gradation ({subject: {sieve: 0.0|1.0}} — a sieve that did not fire is ABSENT, never a third value) and the min() roll-up (never mean — one zero sinks the subject; an empty shake scores 1.0). Berthed HERE because a band's MEANING is block-general and a consumer of the gradation (the sieve-learning nexus is the named candidate) must read it at a general address, not inside one tenant; DERIVATION of a band — reach_of and the ladder — stays with import_sieve, because how a band is computed for an import-shaped sieve is that deriver's own craft. build_inspector rides this berth as tenant #1; the watch that keeps the generality honest is probes/does_the_gradation_find_a_reader.py.
why: Law 2 — CP1-CP6 hold everywhere, including in the process that builds the system. A value enforced by prose is policy; a value carried by a class you cannot subclass without is physics (Law 4). Form v0 #2 lives here for the same reason: a uniform introspection surface on the base means every device is observable by construction, not by each device remembering to be — the tester probes one protocol, the web UI renders one protocol. Placing the values here is necessary but not sufficient: a value is *consumed* only when a per-device contract turns it into a check (CP1 -> no 'done' without an honesty gate). This layer guarantees structural presence and the shape of the introspection surface; consumption is per-device charter work.
invoke: import: `from cairn.base.core_values import CoreValuesMixin, CORE_VALUES`; `from cairn.base.device import BaseDevice`; `from cairn.base.shim import BaseShim`; `from cairn.base.probe import Probe`; `from cairn.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase`; `from cairn.base import transitions`; `from cairn.base.nest import BAND_NAMES, nest, shake`. Prove: `python3 cairn/base/proofs/test_core_values.py`, `test_composition.py`, `test_probe.py`, `test_shim.py`, `test_diagnostic.py`, `test_transitions.py`, `test_nest.py` (each exit 0 = green).
entry: MIXED. core_values.py entered by GRAFT (Law 8) — carried-over-intact from the quarry `UnseenUniversity/.../diagnostic_base/core_values.py` with its pin test; the core values are the one part of the predecessor never the problem (Law 2), ratified by Akien 2026-07-14. device.py + shim.py did NOT graft — UU's `BaseDevice`/`BaseShim`/`DiagnosticBase` (~1000 lines: 14 rack methods, block/halt state model, loguru JSON sinks, dispatch/policy/circuit machinery) are the design Cairn redesigned around. They carry the `CoreValuesMixin` composition and its teeth across, and — added 2026-07-22 — the microsecond-stamp idea into a Cairn-native `DiagnosticBase` (authored fresh: gate-issued thin breadcrumbs home to CC's shim, not loguru sinks); otherwise authored fresh to Cairn's Form v0. Recorded as a redesign, not a graft, so no one mistakes them for carried-over-intact.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split; this file stays pure intention+why, the operational voyage lives in the sidecars (Law 1/4/7)

the 30-day cache-class json log tier in instance-space that the us stamp indexes (v0 mailbox is in-memory)
the log INTERPRETER that crawls the mailbox+logs into a coherent slice (the method's step 2)

gates: proof gate — the two pin tests in proofs/, runnable bare (python3) today; the tester device will own how proofs run when it lands. Durability gate (code-seam): not done until proven AND committed.
falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) the code and the canonical commons record (`CairnCommons/intentions-not-beside-code/core-values.md`) disagree on the set, order, or any narrative (per that record's own falsifier); (2) `CORE_VALUES` is not exactly [CP1..CP6] in order, or the frozen `CoreValue` becomes mutable; (3) `BaseDevice` or `BaseShim` stops composing `CoreValuesMixin`, or any imported subclass of them overrides `CORE_VALUES` to a divergent set; (4) `introspect()` stops reporting intention -> state -> settings in that order; (5) `BaseDevice` stops composing `DiagnosticBase` or `emit` stops being inherited (a device that cannot send diagnostics home breaks 'transition-grade surface everywhere'), or a homeless `emit` silently DROPS a record instead of holding it loud (Law 7 — the silent-red defect this exists to end); (6) the emit-chokepoint (transitions.py) ADMITS an illegal transition — a forward skip past a gate summons, an off-vocabulary target, an unknown class/version, a no-op self-loop, or a path that does not conform to the version it claims — instead of refusing it loudly (that would make the state vocabulary policy again, not physics — Law 4/7), OR journals a crossing anywhere but append-only through the projector door (Law 7).
how_it_learns: The values themselves do not learn autonomously — by design. They are a frozen, ratified contract (Law 2), the terminal floor the rest of the system stands on; nothing-is-terminal does not apply to the axioms themselves. Their horizon is human: the words change only when Akien re-ratifies them (see core-values.md horizon). The Form v0 surface *does* have a learning path, but not here: each device charter answers, for itself, which CP became which enforced check and whether that check earns its keep, and the report *shape* firms up from what its consumers (tester, web UI) actually need. The base only guarantees the six are present to be consumed and the introspection surface is ordered and uniform.

proof: proofs/test_core_values.py — the six in order, the frozen record + lookup helper, and the whitespace-normalized cross-check against core-values.md (drift caught by physics). proofs/test_composition.py — BaseDevice/BaseShim compose the mixin and carry the six, plus a sweep over every imported subclass (armed trap; 0 subclasses today, stated out loud). proofs/test_probe.py — a trigger is any predicate (evaluated where its data is owned), the probe is immutable, a defect is refused at construction. proofs/test_shim.py — a pulse fires due probes onto the bus (holding the rest, batch-surviving a bad one), and the device is woken on demand. proofs/test_active_page.py — the web presentation surface's DATA machinery (web-server child a): the STATUS+SETTINGS floor is projected from introspect(), declared panes append in order (multiples allowed), an unwired or raising handler is loud+absent not fatal, and the whole page json-round-trips (DATA, not HTML). proofs/test_diagnostic.py — the diagnostic surface: the µs stamp is the 6th place after the decimal (none lost), the gate issues a thin breadcrumb pointing to the ticket, it lands home in the mailbox in order, one ticket's entries share the pointer and sort by stamp (the crawl), a homeless emit is held-not-lost (Law 7), emit is inherited structurally (Law 2), and the mailbox is DATA the interpreter can crawl. proofs/test_transitions.py — the emit-chokepoint: a legal forward advance journals the crossing append-only + moves the cursor; the THINKME leaf-fork reaches TICKETME or BUILDME; a forward skip past a gate summons, an off-vocabulary target, an unknown class/version, a no-op, and a path that claims v1 but does not conform are each REFUSED; a back-edge kick-back is legal and carries severity; and it parses a real live ticket's workflow string (trailing prose and all), validated against the real node-class table. proofs/test_nest.py — the general berth: assembly is coarsest-first with empty bands omitted, band names are data a tenant may extend, a toy SECOND tenant shakes string-subjects importing ONLY the general berth (the generality tooth — the berth proven portable before tenant #1 rode it), and scores are binary with a min() roll-up never a mean (an empty shake scores 1.0). Green: run all eight under `python3`.
provenance: core_values.py born 2026-07-17 as the founding stone of the code spine (first class-space code). device.py + shim.py born 2026-07-17 (second step): the base pair, closing the composition-teeth open edge and casting the Form v0 #2 surface. probe.py born 2026-07-18 (evening) and shim.py reworked the same night: the heartbeat+probe+bus rework moved the per-pulse firing INTO the shim (correcting the ground_loop-executor goof) and made the Probe its own primitive — a third base alongside device and shim. Opens the CP/diagnostic base spine step (MAP.md build order) toward the tester as first device.
